title: AC1027 TABLECONTENT 2D and 3D point values

scope.source: Runtime-constructed in-memory DRW_TableContentObject; no DWG/DXF fixture file was added.
scope.record: One unlinked 1x1 TABLECONTENT with ordered String, Long, Double, Point, and Point3d content values.
schema_references: Autodesk AutoCAD .NET DataType enumeration maps Point to 0x10 and Point3d to 0x20: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2026/ENU/OARX-ManagedRefGuide/files/OARX-ManagedRefGuide-Autodesk_AutoCAD_DatabaseServices_DataType.html

Autodesk DXF group-code reference defines 10-17, 20-27, and 30-37 as point/vector coordinate groups: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2027/ENU/OARX-RefGuide/files/OARX-RefGuide-DXF_Group_Codes.html

proof.output: Both output encodings are checked for the exact dataType group 90, byte-size group 92, ordered X/Y[/Z] groups 11/21[/31], and unit group 94; fresh adapter readback checks type, size, coordinate variant, and each coordinate.
proof.failure_retry: A non-finite 3D Z coordinate refuses export and leaves the pre-existing destination sentinel byte-for-byte intact. Restoring Z and retrying on the same writer succeeds. Both ASCII and binary output routes run this control.

limits: This proves adapter-authored AC1027 DXF serialization and readback in one unlinked 1x1 profile; it does not prove native AutoCAD/FreeCAD interpretation or source-origin semantics.

The 8-byte Date type and all other unselected value types remain unqualified. Unit, format, content attributes, formatting overrides, linked-cell values, and broader table shapes remain outside this profile.
next: Resolve the 8-byte Date value's model and DXF wire mapping before admitting it; then select one reproduced content-attribute or formatting refusal and implement its bounded dependency/output path.
